title: What Does It Mean to Be Designated as a Habitual Traffic Offender in Florida?
description: Beginning on **July 1, 2026, Florida Statutes § 322.264, Florida’s Habitual Traffic Offender statute, became harsher under a new law called “Isaiah’s Law” when the Legislature added driving without a valid license under § 322.03 to the offenses that count toward Habitual Traffic Offender status.**
